g.text: Talkboard HID relay PoC / net-label schematic
Every identical net label is connected. NC pins stay open.
MCU1 numbers are physical header pin numbers, not GPIO numbers.
MCU1 pin40 connects ONLY to R12 for sensing; never connect it to the selected +5V_EXT rail.
Remove PC, adapter and battery before wiring. S1 selects adapter / OFF / battery; no charging circuit.
